installer.multiple_installs: select discovered Legacy candidate with most recently modified CitizenFX.ini; explicit FiveMPath overrides
installer.isolation_behavior: rename existing plugins to plugins.before-secret-emko.<timestamp>, create a clean active plugins folder, migrate reshade-shaders only; arbitrary DLL/ASI/add-on hooks remain archived
installer.rollback: restore original plugins folder automatically on failed first isolated install
installer.uninstall: snapshot current SECRET EMKO environment then restore original plugins folder

multiplayer.policy: respect FiveM server plugin policy, Pure Mode, anti-cheat and ReShade restrictions

core.policy: latest official setup appropriate to selected mode

effects.policy: latest packages referenced by shipped presets; unavailable external techniques disabled locally

runtimeCritical.policy: pinned and SHA-256 verified until separately validated
runtimeCritical.reason: DLSS/NR/Bridge binary compatibility is more important than blindly following newest assets
runtimeCritical.bridge: DLSS 5 Bridge v1.4.13-pre8 pinned to commit ecd1b00674020a1e8c76a9cb653a1a21d11676a0 and SHA-256 C4C8B5BC4B26B2B3F3BF2767CDB708546D62F7D0BBB63D24E940C736DA9EFE26.

runtimeOrchestration.control_surface: SECRET EMKO Neural Graphics is the sole intended settings UI
runtimeOrchestration.renodx_visibility: verified v4.70 RenoDX settings overlay is unregistered while SECRET EMKO is active; backend remains registered/loaded
runtimeOrchestration.bridge_visibility: DLSS 5 Bridge has no separate ImGui settings page and remains backend-only

live_apply.bridge: dlss5-bridge.cfg live reload (upstream approximately once per second)
live_apply.renodx: hash/fingerprint-pinned adapter invokes RenoDX v4.70 own settings callback and confirms supported values by readback
live_apply.unsupported_provider_values: persisted but explicitly require restart/provider recreation; never falsely reported as live

lifecycle.neural_off_now: soft-disable RenoDX through verified live control when available; write bridge source=off/synth=0
lifecycle.neural_off_next_start: ReShade DisabledAddons prevents renodx-dlss5.addon64 and dlss5-bridge.addon64 from being loaded
lifecycle.neural_on_when_not_loaded: remove DisabledAddons entries and require one restart so ReShade can load the backends
lifecycle.runtime_unload: never FreeLibrary third-party ReShade add-ons mid-session
lifecycle.neural_runtime_bootstrap: when Full Neural loads, prepare the DLSS SR runtime for FiveM's dynamic subprocess before the synthetic contract is expected to arm; no manual cache-folder DLL copy is required

syntheticFiveM.motion_vectors: ofa_grid 1/2/4 uses DLSS 5 Bridge internal NVIDIA Optical Flow; grid 0 is the explicit external ReShade motion-vector-provider mode.
syntheticFiveM.sr_runtime: SECRET EMKO preloads the pinned nvngx_dlss.dll from plugins and relays the same file beside FiveM's dynamic data/cache/subprocess host via hardlink, with copy fallback. It never writes beside unrelated executables.
syntheticFiveM.runtime_status: UI distinguishes installed files from ARMED/BLOCKED/ACTIVE runtime state; ACTIVE requires delivered-frame telemetry from the current bridge session.

simpleGamingUI.realtime_strength: 0.00-2.00 through verified RenoDX callback/readback when available
simpleGamingUI.advanced_policy: raw provider/bridge controls are hidden under Advanced

nativeFrameGeneration.readiness: fail closed; Streamline/DLSSG DLL presence alone is never treated as a functional FG provider
nativeFrameGeneration.motion: shader-injected GTA motion is the production target; optical flow is not accepted for production FG
nativeFrameGeneration.hud: capture HUD-less scene color plus UI alpha/color separately, then recompose
nativeFrameGeneration.provider_state: RC5 packages a discovery-only provider with ABI/status exports. It observes D3D11/depth/render-target activity but intentionally does not report FG ready until shader motion + HUD/UI + delivery are implemented.
nativeFrameGeneration.coexistence: Compatibility Optical Flow and Frame Generation are mutually exclusive. GTA shader motion can be shared with NR+FG when the provider explicitly reports a shared frame-aligned NR contract.
nativeFrameGeneration.fail_closed: Saved 2x/3x state is rejected at startup if provider readiness regresses; SECRET EMKO restores the compatibility NR path instead of presenting stale FG as active.
